checklist.clock: single clk; BUFG in measurement wrappers; no fabric-gated clock
checklist.reset: SPEC4.2 synchronous rst_n sampled into bridge; local async assertion/two-FF release
checklist.startup: in_ready/out_valid gated by rst_n,meta_sync2 and leaf ready/barrier
checklist.context: pair_accept captures operands/config/C_eff; pair_retire uses all three parser valids
checklist.ce_stall: elastic valid/ready banks hold data; production event regression checked output hold and order
checklist.commit: committed_q prevents repeated accumulator update while output stalled; acc_clr at accept
checklist.reset_abort: reset flushes pending/context/accumulator; accepted=completed+aborted; W14 pilot rechecks
checklist.guideline_mapping: Xilinx ASYNC_REG 2FF implements synchronizer intent; no literal Marvell ASIC cell in FPGA
checklist.methodology: XDCH-2 explained by fixed equal min/max I/O benchmark; CFGBVS/PARTPIN OOC not board pinout

limits: RTL/source plus existing same-hash routed CDC and four-state evidence review; not formal RDC/metastability or board signoff
